questions.question:
Akshay purchased pens and notebooks from a shop for a total sum of ₹180. From the following data, what is the value of ‘X’?

 
 

 **Items**
 **Price per unit (in ₹)**
 **Quantity**
 
 
 
 

 Pens
 10
 X
 
 

 Notebooks
 20
 6
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total cost = ₹180

Price per pen = ₹10

Quantity of pens = X

Price per notebook = ₹20

Quantity of notebooks = 6

**Formula used:**

Total cost = (Price per pen × Quantity of pens) + (Price per notebook × Quantity of notebooks)

**Calculation:**

180 = (10 × X) + (20 × 6)

⇒ 180 = 10X + 120

⇒ 180 - 120 = 10X

⇒ 60 = 10X

⇒ X = 60 ÷ 10

⇒ X = 6

**∴ The value of X is 6.**

Rent = 30%, Education = 25%

Amount spent on any category = (Percentage / 100) × Total income
